SELECT a.id, a.name, a.trigger_type, a.trigger_config, a.condition_tree, a.trigger_event, a.n8n_workflow_id, a.is_active, a.created_at,
  (SELECT MAX(r.ran_at) FROM automation_runs r WHERE r.automation_id = a.id) AS last_run_at,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM automation_runs r WHERE r.automation_id = a.id AND r.status = 'success') AS run_count,
  COALESCE(
    json_agg(
      json_build_object('id', ac.id, 'step_key', ac.step_key, 'parent_step_key', ac.parent_step_key, 'branch', ac.branch, 'action_type', ac.action_type, 'action_config', ac.action_config, 'sort_order', ac.sort_order)
      ORDER BY ac.sort_order
    ) FILTER (WHERE ac.id IS NOT NULL),
    '[]'::json
  ) AS actions
FROM automations a
LEFT JOIN automation_actions ac ON ac.automation_id = a.id
GROUP BY a.id
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC;

INSERT INTO automation_actions (automation_id, branch, action_type, action_config, sort_order, step_key, parent_step_key)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb, $5, $6, $7)
ON CONFLICT (automation_id, step_key) DO UPDATE SET
  branch = EXCLUDED.branch,
  action_type = EXCLUDED.action_type,
  action_config = EXCLUDED.action_config,
  sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order,
  parent_step_key = EXCLUDED.parent_step_key;

parameters.jsCode:
// Dry run: samples live rows for the chosen trigger_type and evaluates
// the condition tree in JS (Evaluate & Respond node) rather than
// executing any action. The sample is NOT filtered by the trigger
// condition in SQL (conditions are evaluated generically in JS, same as
// the Engine), so the LIMIT here has to be generous — a tight LIMIT
// combined with `ORDER BY id DESC` would silently miss the one record
// an admin is actually testing against if it isn't among the newest
// rows. This runs only when a human clicks Test, not on a poll, so a
// few hundred rows is an acceptable cost. Task/Calendar/Pipeline all
// join back to `contacts` for first_name/last_name/email so merge
// fields resolve the same way they do in Automation Engine.json's
// Build Candidate Query — Company triggers have no single associated
// contact, so those stay null. Task and Calendar both read from
// `activities` (see src/types/event.ts) — there is no separate
// calendar_events table in this schema.
//
// Column set mirrors Automation Engine.json's Build Candidate Query
// exactly, so a Test preview matches what a real send would resolve —
// see that node's comment for the full AUTOMATION_DYNAMIC_FIELDS list.
const p = $input.first().json;
const SAMPLE_LIMIT = 200;
const queries = {
  contact: `SELECT c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email, c.phone, c.job_title, c.lead_status, c.birthdate, c.city, c.state, c.zip_code, c.country, c.last_contacted_at, c.lead_source, c.do_not_contact, c.dnc_sms, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.email_logs,
      (c.birthdate IS NOT NULL AND to_char(c.birthdate, 'MM-DD') = to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE COALESCE((SELECT timezone FROM company_profile WHERE id = 1), 'UTC'), 'MM-DD')) AS birthday_today, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM now() AT TIME ZONE COALESCE((SELECT timezone FROM company_profile WHERE id = 1), 'UTC'))::int AS local_hour, c.dnc_email,
      c.id AS contact_id, c.city AS contact_city, c.state AS contact_state, c.zip_code AS contact_zip_code, c.country AS contact_country,
      comp.name AS company_name, comp.id AS company_id, comp.street_address AS company_street_address, comp.zip_code AS company_zip_code,
      comp.phone AS company_phone, comp.website AS company_website, comp.city AS company_city, comp.state AS company_state, comp.country AS company_country, comp.updated_at AS company_updated_at,
      ow.name AS owner_name, ow.email AS owner_email, ow.phone AS owner_phone, ow.email_signature AS owner_signature, ow.id AS owner_user_id,
      (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t.name), '[]'::json) FROM tags t JOIN taggables tg ON tg.tag_id = t.id WHERE tg.entity_type = 'contact' AND tg.entity_id = c.id) AS tags,
      (SELECT company_name FROM company_profile LIMIT 1) AS our_company_name,
      (SELECT row_to_json(b) FROM (SELECT logo_url, address, phone, website, email, brand_color, email_branding_enabled, email_footer_note FROM company_profile WHERE id = 1) b) AS our_branding
    FROM contacts c
    LEFT JOIN companies comp ON comp.id = c.account_id
    LEFT JOIN users ow ON ow.id = c.owner_id
    WHERE c.is_archived = false ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT ${SAMPLE_LIMIT};`,
  company: `SELECT co.id, co.name, NULL::text AS first_name, NULL::text AS last_name, NULL::text AS email, NULL::text AS phone, NULL::text AS job_title, NULL::text AS lead_status,
      co.name AS company_name, co.industry, co.website,
      co.id AS company_id, co.street_address AS company_street_address, co.zip_code AS company_zip_code, co.phone AS company_phone, co.website AS company_website,
      co.city AS company_city, co.state AS company_state, co.country AS company_country, co.updated_at AS company_updated_at,
      ow.name AS owner_name, ow.email AS owner_email, ow.phone AS owner_phone, ow.email_signature AS owner_signature, ow.id AS owner_user_id,
      co.account_status, co.city, co.state, co.country, co.annual_revenue, co.employee_count, co.account_health, co.tier, co.created_at,
      (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t.name), '[]'::json) FROM tags t JOIN taggables tg ON tg.tag_id = t.id WHERE tg.entity_type = 'company' AND tg.entity_id = co.id) AS tags,
      (SELECT company_name FROM company_profile LIMIT 1) AS our_company_name,
      (SELECT row_to_json(b) FROM (SELECT logo_url, address, phone, website, email, brand_color, email_branding_enabled, email_footer_note FROM company_profile WHERE id = 1) b) AS our_branding
    FROM companies co LEFT JOIN users ow ON ow.id = co.owner_id WHERE co.is_archived = false ORDER BY co.id DESC LIMIT ${SAMPLE_LIMIT};`,
  task: `SELECT act.id, act.subject AS name, ct.first_name, ct.last_name, ct.email, ct.phone, ct.dnc_sms, ct.job_title, ct.lead_status,
      ct.id AS contact_id, ct.city AS contact_city, ct.state AS contact_state, ct.zip_code AS contact_zip_code, ct.country AS contact_country,
      ct.birthdate AS contact_birthdate, ct.lead_source AS contact_lead_source, ct.created_at AS contact_created_at, ct.updated_at AS contact_updated_at,
      comp.name AS company_name, comp.id AS company_id, comp.street_address AS company_street_address, comp.zip_code AS company_zip_code,
      comp.phone AS company_phone, comp.website AS company_website, comp.city AS company_city, comp.state AS company_state, comp.country AS company_country, comp.updated_at AS company_updated_at,
      ow.name AS owner_name, ow.email AS owner_email, ow.phone AS owner_phone, ow.email_signature AS owner_signature, ow.id AS owner_user_id,
      act.is_completed, act.due_at, act.type AS event_type, act.start_at, act.end_at, act.location, act.body AS notes,
      (SELECT company_name FROM company_profile LIMIT 1) AS our_company_name,
      (SELECT row_to_json(b) FROM (SELECT logo_url, address, phone, website, email, brand_color, email_branding_enabled, email_footer_note FROM company_profile WHERE id = 1) b) AS our_branding
    FROM activities act
    LEFT JOIN contacts ct ON ct.id = act.contact_id
    LEFT JOIN companies comp ON comp.id = ct.account_id
    LEFT JOIN users ow ON ow.id = act.user_id
    WHERE act.due_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY act.id DESC LIMIT ${SAMPLE_LIMIT};`,
  calendar: `SELECT act.id, act.subject AS name, ct.first_name, ct.last_name, ct.email, ct.phone, ct.dnc_sms, ct.job_title, ct.lead_status,
      ct.id AS contact_id, ct.city AS contact_city, ct.state AS contact_state, ct.zip_code AS contact_zip_code, ct.country AS contact_country,
      ct.birthdate AS contact_birthdate, ct.lead_source AS contact_lead_source, ct.created_at AS contact_created_at, ct.updated_at AS contact_updated_at,
      comp.name AS company_name, comp.id AS company_id, comp.street_address AS company_street_address, comp.zip_code AS company_zip_code,
      comp.phone AS company_phone, comp.website AS company_website, comp.city AS company_city, comp.state AS company_state, comp.country AS company_country, comp.updated_at AS company_updated_at,
      ow.name AS owner_name, ow.email AS owner_email, ow.phone AS owner_phone, ow.email_signature AS owner_signature, ow.id AS owner_user_id,
      act.type AS event_type, act.due_at, act.is_completed, act.start_at, act.end_at, act.location, act.body AS notes, act.is_reschedule, act.outcome, ct.dnc_email,
      ct.unsubscribe_token,
      (SELECT company_name FROM company_profile LIMIT 1) AS our_company_name,
      (SELECT row_to_json(b) FROM (SELECT logo_url, address, phone, website, email, brand_color, email_branding_enabled, email_footer_note FROM company_profile WHERE id = 1) b) AS our_branding
    FROM activities act
    LEFT JOIN contacts ct ON ct.id = act.contact_id
    LEFT JOIN companies comp ON comp.id = ct.account_id
    LEFT JOIN users ow ON ow.id = act.user_id
    WHERE act.due_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY act.id DESC LIMIT ${SAMPLE_LIMIT};`,
  ticket: `SELECT t.id, t.subject AS name, t.status, t.priority, t.sla_due_at, t.created_at, t.resolved_at,
      ct.first_name, ct.last_name, ct.email, ct.phone, ct.dnc_sms, ct.job_title, ct.lead_status,
      ct.id AS contact_id, ct.city AS contact_city, ct.state AS contact_state, ct.zip_code AS contact_zip_code, ct.country AS contact_country,
      ct.birthdate AS contact_birthdate, ct.lead_source AS contact_lead_source, ct.created_at AS contact_created_at, ct.updated_at AS contact_updated_at,
      co.name AS company_name, co.id AS company_id, co.street_address AS company_street_address, co.zip_code AS company_zip_code,
      co.phone AS company_phone, co.website AS company_website, co.city AS company_city, co.state AS company_state, co.country AS company_country, co.updated_at AS company_updated_at,
      ow.name AS owner_name, ow.email AS owner_email, ow.phone AS owner_phone, ow.email_signature AS owner_signature, ow.id AS owner_user_id,
      (SELECT company_name FROM company_profile LIMIT 1) AS our_company_name,
      (SELECT row_to_json(b) FROM (SELECT logo_url, address, phone, website, email, brand_color, email_branding_enabled, email_footer_note FROM company_profile WHERE id = 1) b) AS our_branding
    FROM tickets t
    LEFT JOIN contacts ct ON ct.id = t.contact_id
    LEFT JOIN companies co ON co.id = t.account_id
    LEFT JOIN users ow ON ow.id = t.assigned_user
    WHERE t.is_archived = false ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT ${SAMPLE_LIMIT};`,
  pipeline: `SELECT o.id, o.name, o.deal_value, o.expected_close, o.source, o.priority, o.stage_entered_at,
      o.status, o.probability, o.lost_reason, o.created_at, o.updated_at,
      GREATEST(o.updated_at, COALESCE(la.last_activity, o.updated_at)) AS last_touched_at,
      ct.first_name, ct.last_name, ct.email, ct.phone, ct.dnc_sms, ct.job_title, ct.lead_status, ct.city, ct.state, ct.country,
      ct.id AS contact_id, ct.city AS contact_city, ct.state AS contact_state, ct.zip_code AS contact_zip_code, ct.country AS contact_country,
      ct.birthdate AS contact_birthdate, ct.lead_source AS contact_lead_source, ct.created_at AS contact_created_at, ct.updated_at AS contact_updated_at,
      co.name AS company_name, co.industry, co.website,
      co.id AS company_id, co.street_address AS company_street_address, co.zip_code AS company_zip_code, co.phone AS company_phone, co.website AS company_website,
      co.city AS company_city, co.state AS company_state, co.country AS company_country, co.updated_at AS company_updated_at,
      ow.name AS owner_name, ow.email AS owner_email, ow.phone AS owner_phone, ow.email_signature AS owner_signature, ow.id AS owner_user_id,
      o.pipeline_id, o.stage_id, st.name AS stage_name, pl.name AS pipeline_name,
      prop.id AS proposal_id, prop.public_token AS proposal_token, prop.status AS proposal_status, prop.emailed_at AS proposal_emailed_at, prop.viewed_at AS proposal_viewed_at,
      contr.id AS contract_id, contr.public_token AS contract_token, contr.status AS contract_status, contr.sent_at AS contract_sent_at, contr.signed_at AS contract_signed_at,
      (SELECT company_name FROM company_profile LIMIT 1) AS our_company_name,
      (SELECT row_to_json(b) FROM (SELECT logo_url, address, phone, website, email, brand_color, email_branding_enabled, email_footer_note FROM company_profile WHERE id = 1) b) AS our_branding,
      ct.unsubscribe_token,
      appt.activity_id, appt.due_at, appt.start_at, appt.end_at, appt.location,
      appt.appointment_subject, appt.activity_is_completed
    FROM opportunities o
    LEFT JOIN contacts ct ON ct.id = o.contact_id
    LEFT JOIN companies co ON co.id = o.account_id
    LEFT JOIN users ow ON ow.id = o.assigned_user
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT opportunity_id, MAX(created_at) AS last_activity FROM activities GROUP BY opportunity_id) la ON la.opportunity_id = o.id
    LEFT JOIN stages st ON st.id = o.stage_id
    LEFT JOIN pipelines pl ON pl.id = o.pipeline_id
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT p.id, p.public_token, p.status, p.emailed_at, p.viewed_at FROM proposals p WHERE p.opportunity_id = o.id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
    ) prop ON true
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT c2.id, c2.public_token, c2.status, c2.sent_at, c2.signed_at FROM contracts c2 WHERE c2.opportunity_id = o.id ORDER BY c2.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
    ) contr ON true
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT a.id AS activity_id, a.due_at, a.start_at, a.end_at, a.location, a.subject AS appointment_subject, a.is_completed AS activity_is_completed
      FROM activities a WHERE a.opportunity_id = o.id AND a.type = 'meeting'
      ORDER BY a.is_completed ASC, a.due_at DESC LIMIT 1
    ) appt ON true
    WHERE o.is_archived = false ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT ${SAMPLE_LIMIT};`,
};
const sqlQuery = queries[p.triggerType];
if (!sqlQuery) throw new Error('Unsupported trigger_type.');
return [{ json: { sqlQuery, queryParams: [] } }];

const original = $('Evaluate & Respond').item.json;
return [{ json: { ...original, test_email_sent: true } }];
return [{ json: $('Evaluate & Respond').item.json }];

Please check the values and try again."; else if (/value too long/i.test(m)) m = "One of the values is too long."; return { success: false, error: m }; })() }}
